label: Dagu DGServo 9g (End View)
description:
Dagu DGServo 9g (End View - Incl. PCB Connector)

The breadboard view is rendered as non-perspective end projection and is especially useful for representing the upper servo in the Dagu Pan and Tilt mechanism.

The female header connector normally attached to end of the servo wires, exists in Fritzing as a separate part in the Dagu bin. Simply plug the connector onto whichever header pins you are using, then attach the wires to the connector.
